listing.name: Macross VF-X2 — Macross-VFX-2-Recomp (omegakatana92)
listing.summary: Upstream reports working graphics, gameplay and performance while describing the project as unfinished. Full completion is unconfirmed; Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Japanese Macross VF-X2 disc. The exact serial number and revision are unspecified; check upstream before preparing files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Complete the upstream first-run Generate & rebuild process with your own disc to generate OpenBIOS and game C code, then build the local runtime. A manual MinGW/CMake route is also documented. Portcove does not install or prepare this source project automatically.

warnings: Upstream reports working graphics, gameplay and performance while describing the project as unfinished. Full completion is unconfirmed; Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
